title: GameLobby Survival+
description: Vanilla+ modpack for aims to improve preformance, stability and QOL mods.
body:
This modpack aims to improve vanilla minecrafts performance and stability. Also includes quality of life mods that doest effect vanilla vibes. If you want to play more stable and enhanced minecraft feel free to give a try. I'm developing this pack for both SMP and singleplayers.

Performance Mods:
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (chunk generation speed improvements)
- FerriteCore (memory usage optimizations)
- ImmediatelyFast (Entity, Map, HUD, Text and Block-Entity rendering improvements)
- Lithium (game physics, mob AI, block ticking improvements)
- ScalableLux (light update improvements)
- Sodium (rendering optimization mod, micro-stutter fixes and fixing many graphical issues)
- spark (it is not a performance mode but a performance analysis mode)
- Chunky (Pre-generates chunks who has problem with generating chunks)
  
Custom World Generation Mods:
- Biomes O' Plenty (Adds 50+ unique biomes)
- Dungeons+ (30+ brand new immersive underground dungeons and structures)
- Explorify (vanilla-friendly collection of new structures)
- Towns and Towers (new villages, pillager outposts, and even new ships!)

To Improve Vanilla Minecraft Mods:
- Easy Anvils (Overhauled anvils! Items stay, better name tags, many tweaks!)
- Easy Magic (Enchanting tables as they always should have been! Items stay after closing, and easy re-rolls.)
- Iris Shaders (A modern shader pack loader)
- Jade 🔍 (Shows information about what you are looking at.)
- Just Hammers (Adds hammers to the game that are able to mine in a 3x3, 3x3x3, 5x5x1, 5x5x3 and finally a 5x5x5!)
- Mouse Tweaks (Enhances inventory management by adding various functions to the mouse buttons.)
- Rechiseled (Allows you to chisel blocks into various decorative blocks with connected textures!)
- Veinminer (Mine a single ore to break the full vein of the same ore!)
- Reinforced Barrels,Chests and Shulker Boxes (adds tiered storages)

And much more!

**WARNING!!!**
This pack is still WIP, mods may be removed and added in progress.

Server file will be included after stable version is released.
